leak: Entry fills already past its target

decision_record.transfer: A Lazarus fire's edge is the move from its print toward its target over its horizon; once the current price is already at/past the target (or past a designed max-price cap), that move is spent -- the remaining expectancy is the spread/slippage of an immediate exit.
decision_record.comparison: Control (shadow/faithful): enter whenever the fire print passes the spec gates. Treatment: revalidate target_price and spec max_price at the fresh execution price (batch-1 reprice price) and refuse breaches.
decision_record.mechanism: Batch-1 reprice sized off the fresh close but never re-checked the designed bounds against it: max_price was tested on the fire print only, and target_price was stored for exits but never tested on entry, so a gapped-up name entered already past its own target and exited on the next evaluation.
decision_record.calculation: Fixture (blockers): s_1wc_micro fire $10 target $11, fresh close $12.50 -> ON 0 entries + paired journal refuse_bound; OFF 1 entry qty 80. s_1wsw_stress fire $4.00 (passes <$5 gate), fresh $6.00 -> ON 0, OFF 1. s_1wlab fire target $20, fresh $12 -> ON still enters.
